resources.string: The bridge watches the car around the clock and this phone shows its alerts — at once while the app is open, otherwise within the hour (every few minutes while charging or preheating). This phone\'s own checks are off while it uses the bridge.
This phone checks for alerts itself, only while it\'s connected to the car.
If the car is home and not plugged in at this time, the bridge reminds every phone — only when the battery is below the level you pick. Set here for all phones.
The bridge didn\'t answer — this can be changed when the phone reaches the bridge.
